text: The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee asks that members of Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit Staff provide a verbal update on the Dundas Street renaming at our next Committee meeting.

The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Manager, Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit, in consultation with City staff involved in the renaming of Dundas Street, to provide a verbal update on the Dundas Street renaming at the September 24, 2021, meeting of the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee.
